versions.changelog:
No changes detected in this version.

- Version bumped to 1.2.4 with no file or documentation updates.

- Added metadata fields: version, license, and tags for better skill description and categorization.
- Introduced a <scripts> section with usage details for the main script.
- No changes to core functionality or usage instructions.

Initial release of cn-slug-generator.

- Converts Chinese titles to SEO-friendly URL slugs.
- Supports English translation and pinyin modes.
- Preserves numbers and common symbols.
- Enables batch conversion via command line.
- Customizable slug separator and output file options.
- Requires Python 3.x; pypinyin needed for pinyin mode.
